```{r load tables, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}


temp <- read.table(here("output/temp/temp_strain_table.txt"), header = T)
biofilm <- read.table(here("output/biofilm/biofilm_strain_table.txt"), header = T)
pH <- read.table(here("output/pH/pH_strain_table.txt"), header = T)

## Let's get the metadata info for each strain. For that we need to read in the master metadata table.
master_md <- read.table(here("data/shared/master_md_all_sequenced_Isolates_with_extendedMD.txt"), header = T, sep = "\t")

master_md <- master_md %>% select(Name, clade, subclade)


#now let's match the clade colors to the metadata
clade_colors <- read.table(here("data/shared/clade_colors.txt"), header = T, sep = "\t", comment.char = "")

clades_colors <- deframe(clade_colors)


temp <- temp |>
  filter(!is.na(StrainID) & StrainID != "08G4B02")


main <- biofilm |>
  left_join(temp, by = "StrainID") |>
  mutate(temp = case_when(is.na(temp) ~ "no",
                        .default = temp)) |>
  left_join(pH, by = "StrainID") |>
  mutate(pH = case_when(is.na(pH) ~ "no",
                        .default = pH)) |>
  left_join(master_md, by = c("StrainID" = "Name"))

main_long <- main %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(temp, biofilm, pH),
    names_to  = "assay",
    values_to = "tested"
  ) %>%
  filter(tested == "yes")

# summarize
sum_assay <- main_long %>% 
  distinct(StrainID, assay) %>% 
  count(assay)

# bar chart
ggplot(sum_assay, aes(x = assay, y = n, fill = assay)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    x = "Assay",
    y = "Number of strains",
    title = "Strains per assay"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

sum_clade <- main_long %>%
  count(assay, clade)

ggplot(sum_clade, aes(x = assay, y = n, fill = clade)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clades_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Assay",
    y = "Number of strains",
    fill = "Clade",
    title = "Strains per assay, by clade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

sum_sub <- main_long %>%
  count(assay, clade, subclade)

ggplot(sum_sub |> filter(!clade  %in%  c("UND", "V") & !is.na(clade)),
       aes(x = assay, y = n, fill = subclade)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clades_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ clade) +
  labs(
    x = "Assay",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Subclade",
    title = "Subclade breakdown per assay, faceted by clade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

library(ggh4x)

ggplot(sum_sub |> filter(!clade  %in%  c("UND", "V") & !is.na(clade) & !is.na(subclade)),
       aes(x = assay, y = n, fill = subclade)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clades_colors) +
  facet_nested( ~ clade + subclade, scales = "free_y", space = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Assay",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Subclade",
    title = "Assays × Clade/Subclade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)
  )



# 1. Identify strains tested in all three assays
all3 <- main %>%
  filter(temp == "yes", biofilm == "yes", pH == "yes")

# 2. How many?
n_all3 <- n_distinct(all3$StrainID)
message("Number of strains assayed for all three traits: ", n_all3)

# 3. Distribution by clade
ggplot(all3 |> filter(!clade  %in%  c("UND", "V") & !is.na(clade) & !is.na(subclade)),
       aes(x = clade)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = clade)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clades_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Clade",
    y = "Number of strains",
    title = "Strains assayed for temp, biofilm, and pH\n(broken down by clade)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 4. Distribution by subclade (faceted)
ggplot(all3 |> filter(!clade  %in%  c("UND", "V") & !is.na(clade) & !is.na(subclade)),
       aes(x = subclade)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = subclade)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clades_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ clade, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Subclade",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Subclade breakdown of fully-assayed strains"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

library(ggvenn)

# same sets list as above

  Temp    = unique(main$StrainID[main$temp    == "yes"]),

# ggvenn
```

```{r correlations, fig.width=25, fig.height=20}
library(Hmisc)
library(corrplot)

pH_params <- read.table(here("output/pH/curve_params.tsv"), header = T)
pH_params <- pH_params |> rename(strain = Strain)

temp_params <- read.table(here("output/temp/temp_curve_params_table.txt"), header = T)
biofilm <- read.table(here("output/biofilm/biofilm_avg_data.txt"), header = T)

### first correlations with pH parameters

pH_num <- pH_params[ , sapply(pH_params, is.numeric) ]
pH_res <- rcorr(as.matrix(pH_num), type = "pearson")

pH_corr_mat <- pH_res$r      # correlation coefficients
pH_p_mat    <- pH_res$P      # corresponding p‐values

#dim(pH_corr_mat)
#dim(pH_p_mat)
#names(pH_corr_mat)
#names(pH_p_mat)

pH_p_mat[is.na(pH_p_mat)] <- 0

# Only show significant correlations (p < 0.05):
pH_corrplot <- corrplot(
  pH_corr_mat,
  method        = "circle",
  type          = "upper",
  tl.col        = "black",
  addCoef.col   = "black",    # add correlation coefficients
  diag = F,
  p.mat         = pH_p_mat,
  sig.level     = 0.05,
  insig         = "blank"     # hide nonsignificant
)

GGally::ggpairs(pH_num, columns = 1:ncol(pH_num))

panel_scatter_info <- function(data, mapping, method = "pearson",
                               box_alpha = 0.25,  # 0 = fully transparent, 1 = opaque
                               box_fill  = "white",
                               text_size = 4,
                               pad_lines = 0.06,  # tighter box padding
                               ...) {
  x  <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y  <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)

  ct  <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = method))
  fit <- stats::lm(y ~ x, subset = ok)
  lab <- sprintf("r = %.2f\np = %.3g\nR² = %.2f\nn = %d",
                 ct$estimate, ct$p.value, summary(fit)$r.squared, sum(ok))

  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("label",
             x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1,
             label = lab, size = text_size, lineheight = 0.9,
             label.size = 0,                                # no border
             label.r = unit(0.05, "lines"),                 # small corner radius
             label.padding = unit(pad_lines, "lines"),      # tighter box
             fill = alpha(box_fill, box_alpha))             # translucent fill
}

panel_cor_sig <- function(data, mapping, method = "pearson", alpha = 0.05, ...) {
  x <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
  ct <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = method))
  r  <- unname(ct$estimate); p <- ct$p.value
  lab <- sprintf("%.2f%s", r,
                 ifelse(p < .001, "***", ifelse(p < .01, "**", ifelse(p < .05, "*", ""))))
  sig <- is.finite(p) && p < alpha

  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = .5, y = .5, label = lab, size = 5,
             fontface = if (sig) "bold" else "plain",
             colour   = if (sig) "firebrick" else "grey40") +
    theme_void()
}

panel_scatter_sig <- function(data, mapping, method = "lm", alpha = 0.05, ...) {
  x <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
  p  <- tryCatch(stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok])$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  sig <- is.finite(p) && p < alpha

  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = if (sig) 0.7 else 0.15) +
    geom_smooth(method = method, se = FALSE,
                linewidth = if (sig) 0.9 else 0.4,
                linetype  = if (sig) "solid" else "dashed")
}

GGally::ggpairs(
  merged_num,
  columns = colnames_r,
  lower = list(continuous = panel_scatter_sig),
  upper = list(continuous = panel_cor_sig),
```
